findings: C counts separately bribable candidate groups per audit, not the number of levels.
The geometric bound is conditional on the stated bribery regime and detection after every earlier miss. Disjoint groups or marginal error rates alone do not establish it.
The tower explicitly retains a trustworthy terminal adjudicator; it does not eliminate all grader trust.
The bribery-payoff calculation and probabilistic contraction are distinct conditional claims, not general incentive compatibility.

conditional_probability_check.example: If every level misses the same latent 20% of faults, its marginal detection is 80%, but survival after three levels remains 20%, rather than 0.2 cubed = 0.8%.
conditional_probability_check.meaning: Full independence is not necessary when the theorem supplies the conditional detection bound. The counterexample shows why a marginal rate or group labels do not suffice.
